errors.evidence: The line does not end at -5.5 Euro/MWh. The final data point on the graph is at approximately -2 Euro/MWh. The minimum value reached in February is closer to -6 Euro/MWh, not -5.5.
The description fails to mention the prominent horizontal black reference line at the y-value of 0.

errors.text_span: ending at around -5.5 Euro/MWh in February 2025, with a notable spike to around -2 Euro/MWh at the very end of the graph
errors.evidence: This phrasing is confusing. It incorrectly identifies the minimum value in February as the 'ending' point and then describes the actual final point as a separate 'spike'. The line reaches a minimum of approx. -6 and then rises to end at approx. -2.
